faq.q: Can I join the German A2 course in Dehradun without doing A1 here?
faq.a: Yes, after a short level check with one of our trainers. If you have finished A1 elsewhere or studied German at school, we place you in the A2 batch that fits your level.

faq.q: What will I learn in the German A2 course?
faq.a: German A2 covers the Perfekt, modal verbs, the dative case, separable verbs and subordinate clauses with weil and dass, so you can talk about your routine, the past and simple plans.

faq.q: What does the Goethe-Zertifikat A2 exam include?
faq.a: The Goethe A2 exam tests reading short texts, listening to dialogues and announcements, writing short messages, and holding short conversations on everyday topics. We train each part with mock tests in Dehradun.

faq.q: Is the Perfekt tense difficult in German A2?
faq.a: It becomes easy with practice. In our A2 classes we drill the common verbs with haben and sein in speaking tasks until the pattern feels natural.

faq.q: Are online German A2 classes available?
faq.a: Yes. Join German A2 classes online or offline at our Race Course centre in Dehradun, in morning, evening or personalised batches.
